title: Prime numbers climb through through slumbers of unrest together able to pluck value from factors core to our being bearing fruit seeing roots to diliu
summary: Prime numbers climb through through slumbers of unrest together able to pluck value from factors core to our being bearing fruit seeing roots to diliute the unmeaning craft the infinite but always broken in two #tdc3099 #ds106 #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Prime numbers
climb through
through slumbers
of unrest
together able
to pluck
value from
  factors core
to our being
  bearing fruit
seeing roots
to diliute
the unmeaning
craft the infinite
but always
broken in two
#tdc3099 #ds106
#smallpoems
